therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: DNA damage repair pathway disruption in BRCA-deficient tumors
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Participants with BRCA1 and BRCA2 mutation and metastatic breast cancer

results.effect_size: HR 0.789, 95% CI 0.536-1.162 (veliparib + carboplatin/paclitaxel vs placebo + carboplatin/paclitaxel); HR 1.858, 95% CI 1.278-2.702 (veliparib + TMZ vs placebo + carboplatin/paclitaxel)
subgroup_findings: Veliparib + carboplatin/paclitaxel showed higher ORR (77.8%) vs placebo + carboplatin/paclitaxel (61.3%), p=0.027
Veliparib + TMZ showed lower ORR (28.6%) vs placebo + carboplatin/paclitaxel (61.3%), p<0.001
safety_signals: Increased febrile neutropenia with veliparib + carboplatin/paclitaxel (7/93) vs placebo + carboplatin/paclitaxel (2/96)

context.duration: Maximum follow-up for PFS was 34 months, maximum follow-up for OS was 72 months
